purpose: Independent INV154 calling-thread interpretation question; separate from existing frozen and challenge sets.

questions.query: Does a long Windows Rapier space_step prove CPU computation, and can per-thread CPU time distinguish waiting from descheduling?
facts: Wall time alone does not prove CPU computation; aligned calling-thread execution counters can separate caller execution from off-CPU time with explicit accounting uncertainty.
Calling-thread off-CPU time does not distinguish blocked from ready-but-descheduled time or exclude computation on internal Rapier workers.
Classification requires repeated profiling comparisons, sufficient long events, timing alignment and bounded perturbation; a different GPU host with no events is inconclusive.
